# Amit Kaplinsky

> Twelve years across enterprise and founding-stage cybersecurity, working from product direction and operating models through interaction design, systems, and AI-assisted builds.

## Homepage

- Headline: Making complex security operations clear enough to act on.
- URL: https://amitkap.com/

## Work

- [Shift | Founding Designer](https://amitkap.com/work/shift): A third-party security platform connecting agent-led assessment, vendor access, exposure, and human judgment.
- [Onyxia | Product Design Team Lead](https://amitkap.com/work/onyxia-cyber): Connecting benchmarks and SLAs to the owners, tasks, progress, and delays behind them.
- [Veriti | Founding Designer](https://amitkap.com/work/veriti): Safe, multi-vendor remediation connecting a known exposure to an explained and approved control change.
- [Semperis | UX Team Lead](https://amitkap.com/work/semperis): A product language for Active Directory recovery, continuous risk, attention, and action.
- [Check Point Software | UX Expert](https://amitkap.com/work/checkpoint): Enterprise security management reorganized around products, objects, policies, and daily security work.

## Writing

- [Designing for the Supervisor](https://amitkap.com/case-studies/designing-for-the-supervisor): How a market scan and product-strategy reframe turned third-party risk from an analyst workspace into a system for supervising AI agents.
- [Falling down the rabbit hole](https://amitkap.com/case-studies/falling-down-the-rabbit-hole): How a Check Point team adapted an enterprise product process to ship WatchTower for iOS and Android.
- [Sailing the Data Oceans](https://amitkap.com/case-studies/sailing-the-data-oceans): How we designed a composable filter grammar for high-volume security insights inside an existing product.
